test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 11

questions.question: A cistern has a hole in the bottom through which water is leaking. A tap can fill the cistern in 6 hours and the hole in the bottom can empty the fully filled cistern in 7 hours. If both the tap and the hole are open, then how long will it take to completely fill the empty cistern?733
The product of two numbers is 16245 and their HCF is 57. Find their LCM.1135
Pulkit pours 5 litres of liquid into a tank every 4 minutes, while Shahu pours 4 litres every 5 minutes. How much time will they take together to fill a tank with 410 litres of liquid?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (More than 3 hours) है।

questions.question: If the mean proportional of X and 100 is 90, then find the value of X.
A shopkeeper lists the price of a fan at 50% above its cost price and offers a 30% discount on its list price. If he earns a profit of ₹87, then what is the list price (in ₹) of the fan?192

In an election between three candidates, Adam gets 45% of the total valid votes and Lucas received 40% of votes received by Adam. If the total number of votes was 40,000 and 20% of the total votes were declared invalid, then the number of valid votes received by third candidate Nic was:109
options: three-fourth of the votes received by Adam
double of votes received by Lucas
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (37% of total valid votes) है।

questions.question: In what ratio should sugar costing ₹86 per kg be mixed with sugar costing ₹11 per kg so that by selling the mixture at ₹44.80 per kg, there is a profit of 40%?324
The sum of five numbers is 655. The average of the first two numbers is 80 and the third number is 132. Find the average of the remaining two numbers.301
A train crosses a platform in 4 seconds and a man standing on the platform in 2 seconds. Find the length of the train and its speed, if the length of the platform is 80 m.696
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (80 m and 40 m/s) है।

Find the compound interest on ₹8,000 after 3 years if the rate of interest is 5% per annum for the first year, 6% per annum for the second year and 8% per annum for the third year.
A man decides to travel 54 km in 6 hours partly by foot and partly on a bicycle. If his speed on foot is 6 km/hr and on the bicycle is 18 km/hr, what distance (in km) will he travel on foot?
A 126-litre mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 4 : 3. How many litres of water must be added to make the ratio of milk to water 1 : 1?

The distance between two points, X and Y, is 150 km. Car A starts from X at x km/hr and travels towards Y, while Car B starts from Y at y km/hr and travels towards X. If both cars start their journeys at the same time, they meet 2 hours after starting. Now, suppose both Car A and Car B start at the same time from X, traveling towards Y at x km/hr and y km/hr, respectively. After reaching Y, they turn back immediately and start their return journey to X. Car A reaches Y and starts back towards X. On the way back, it meets Car B, which is still on its way to Y. If the distance of Y from the meeting point is half the distance of X from that same point, how much time does Car A take to travel from X to Y?
A shopkeeper offers a scheme of two successive discounts of 10% and 20% on all items in his shop. Find the single discount percentage equivalent to the offered discounts.

A and B invested ₹6,00,000 and ₹9,00,000 in a business, respectively. They decided to share 40% of the profit equally between them and rest of the profit in the ratio of their investments. What amount of profit (in ₹) did A receive if the total profit is 10% more than their total investment?
